acceptance: Reduce real startup-to-ready latency on the same local session corpus vs prior ~350s readiness.
Keep complete typed session validation and fresh byte SHA256 checks; preserve migration/rollback, integrity, task recovery and numbering.
Do not rewrite unchanged session files; persist actual interrupted-task changes.
Record phase timings, safety regressions, benchmark and real build/start evidence.

requirements.summary: User requests diagnosis and actual startup speed improvement. Corpus: 189 files, 6251775654 bytes; previous direct readiness ~350s.

design.summary: Per-boot typed decode reuse keyed by exact SHA256 of freshly read bytes. Reuse across migration, integrity and loading through first image-upgrade readiness; drop cache then. Save only sessions changed by restart recovery; emit aggregate stage timings.

implementation.summary: Per-boot byte-SHA256 keyed typed-session reuse across all startup validation passes; unchanged sessions no longer saved; recovery and assistant result wake preserved; aggregate phase timings added.

verification.summary: 64 relevant race regressions passed, no skips. New image startup phase sum 91.590s (constructor 75.328s plus ready-integrity 16.262s), versus previous approximately 350s. Repeat ordinary start after container restart measured 75.942s to verified host HTTPS and exit=0. Complete offline resource check passed. All 189 session files retained with unchanged size/mtime; zero startup recovery writes.

documentation.summary: Updated launcher contract with startup cache lifetime, exact-content checks, conditional persistence and timing diagnostics. Task records actual measurements and observer limitation.

cleanup.summary: Task-scoped diffs reviewed, test containers auto-removed, original session data preserved; evidence retained privately under .agent-state. Pre-change runtime tag retained for rollback.

release.summary: Local source/runtime fix only; no commit, push, version bump or public release.

rollback: Preserve pre-change runtime tag; existing user corpus stays intact except required recovery/migration writes.
handoff: Updated local source runtime installed and healthy at https://localhost:9999/. First image startup about 92s, ordinary restart 75.942s; remaining dominant phase is one full decode of the 5.8GiB corpus (~59s). This is not instantaneous or lazy loading. No full application/UI acceptance, public release or Windows/Linux physical acceptance claimed. Optional post-build cache recycling skipped on initial run due to lagging Docker health flag.

new_image_startup.note: First-ready observer received success but its nanosecond timestamp parsing failed; phase sum from real service logs is used, not an invented exact observer duration.
